proposals.title: Ding! Nounish Event Reminder
proposals.tldr: A plug-and-play Twitter automation that tweets Lil Nouns events from Google Calendar.
proposals.content:
A lot of activities are on Lil Nouns, it is sometimes difficult to keep up, especially for busy Lil nouners.

- Proposals,

- Prop house beginning and end dates

- Discord events

- Twitter Spaces.

There should be a better way of keeping up. Imagine ‘subscribing’ to a Twitter bot that simply aggregates and notifies you about these events.

![Screenshot-2022-1007-200654.jpg](https://i.postimg.cc/hG0LMFQQ/Screenshot-2022-1007-200654.jpg)

I’d like to build a Twitter bot with the following functionalities:

- read events in a specific calendar on Google Calendar

- send a tweet out before the event

- users opt in/opt out of receiving DMs for specific events.

I understand the community is interested in this and so i went ahead and created a working sample for the opt-in feature. This will let users send tweets, and book events that will be moderated and added to the calendar.

I am scoping the product more, and it will take me 15 days to deliver a fully functioning Twitter automation that listens to Google Calendar events.

**Who am I?**

I am Tolo. I like developing useful things. Collaborating with other Lil nouners, I am building in the community.

proposals.content:
![](data:image/png;base64,)

 Hey! 👋 I'm [@danizord](https://twitter.com/danizord), independent web3 builder and LilNouner #4366.

Last month I was messing with development of Alexa skills, and that resulted in the development a [skill for Nouns DAO](https://prop.house/nouns/round-7/877) called [@NounAssistant](https://twitter.com/NounAssistant/status/1576197915173097473), which was funded by [PropHouse](https://prop.house/nouns/round-7/877). It's been working great, the MVP is validated. Now I want to add more features to it :)

I got a lot of positive feedback when I commented in Twitter about adding support for Lil Nouns, and as a Lil Nouner I'd love to use it to help me keep up with governance proposals and have quick answers about Lil Nouns. So my proposal here is to take another iteration on it, adding support for Lil Nouns and more features:

- Daily flash briefing for Lil Nouns.
- Answer which proposals are open for voting.
- Answer about the status of a specific proposal ID.
- Answer about recent Lil Nouns auctions: number of sales, average winning bid, etc.
- Answer questions about the treasury.
- Answer questions about the Lil Nouns secondary market: floor price, average price, etc.
- Read the news from [Lil Nouns Weekly Newsletter](https://lilnouns.substack.com/).
- (???) open for suggestions :)

I'll do my best to provide all those features in both pt-BR and en-US. Please ping me if you want to help translating to your language :)

![](https://aws1.discourse-cdn.com/standard21/uploads/nouns/optimized/2X/0/073adca9c782f915fafb88131fdda4461931c40c_2_690x255.png)

Questions? Suggestions? Feel free to ping me in Discord at Danizord#0001 or twitter @Danizord.

Thanks for your attention. I hope you like it :)

proposals.content:
Hi, I'm [motiondesign.eth](https://twitter.com/motiondesigneth), or ⌐◨-◨.lilnouns.eth

proposals.author: 0x6cc34d9fb4ae289256fc1896308d387aee2bcc52
proposals.title: Lil Nouns Launchpad
proposals.tldr: Discover & upvote the best projects created by the Lil Nouns community.
proposals.content:
We want to build a Product Hunt like platform for Lil Nouns.

**Values:**

- Showcase and promote the best projects in Lil Nouns
- Advertise the strength of the builders in the community
- Give builders a platform to find users and get feedback
- Encourage everyone in the community to build & get recognition
**Why?**

Lil Nouns community members already create tons of interesting stuff, but knowledge about it is scattered and for average user it's difficult to find the best projects that have been built.

Also, for builders very often the most challenging problem is finding early adopters, getting initial feedback and product validation.

[Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com) is great platform and very popular place to discover new products. Inspired by it, we want to create something similar, but tailored for the Lil Nouns community.

**Background**

As Collective, we've already built ["Projects"](https://collective.xyz/lil-nouns/projects) section on our platform and received a lot of valuable feedback.

Current solution is far away from being perfect, but a very solid base for further development. Initially we were focused on showing work-in-progress projects and encourage builders to regularly share progress.

We've learnt, that it's not exactly what the community needs - that's why we want to focus more on product launches to help builders getting their projects in front of the community.

**Deliverables**

[https://nounslaunchpad.wtf](https://nounslaunchpad.wtf)

1) Lil Nouns Projects list with upvotes functionality

- All time best projects
- This month leaderboard (with “Project of the Month” badge for the winner)
2) Project home page, focused on graphic assets, short descriptions, deliverables and users feedback

3) Monthly newsletter showcasing top projects & builders

4) Showing builder data on a builders directory page, giving builders the recognition they deserve

**Roadmap**

Launching within 2-3 weeks

**About us**

- Wojciech Kocjan (Discord: Woj#2938, [https://github.com/wkocjan](https://github.com/wkocjan))
- László Horváth (Discord: laslow#4464, [https://github.com/laszlo-horvath](https://github.com/laszlo-horvath))
We’re experienced full stack developers, both with several years of experience in developing delightful products.

proposals.content:
# Lil bounty hunter

**Longer TL;DR**: An auto-minter contract: Put some bounties up for heads and traits you want, deposit some ETH in it. He'll auto-settle the Lin nouns auctions at the right time to mint a matching lil and bid on it up to how much you're willing to pay. If he wins the auction, that lil is yours

![](data:image/png;base64,)

lil Stingy might make you cry, but he'll get you what you want

## What's this?

Tired of waiting for the perfect lil? Tired of the bid wars over the most desired heads? Well, I'd rather not  get involved with lil Stingy over there, but he's the lil that gets the job done, y'know.

Just tell him the target's **head** and the **glasses**, **bodies**, **accessories** it's usually seen with, and he'll fetch him for you.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

His only rule: You pay up front (He's tired of getting rugged). But don't worry, you can get your money back (minus gas and settlement expenses, ofc) if he can't get the job done.

## Who am I?

Hey there, I'm [@volky](https://twitter.com/volkyeth)(#0001 on Discord 👾)

I'm a full-stack Web3 dev building for the Nouns Ecosystem. You might know me by my [previous prop](https://prop.house/nouns/round-8/1070), that gave birth to [Noundry Studio](https://studio.noundry.wtf), or you might know me for my current involvement with [Nouns101](https://lilnouns.wtf/vote/57)

proposals.content:
**Who Am I**

I am Leo Pastel. I’m a singer/songwriter/producer/graphic designer. I am originally from Cincinnati, Ohio & currently reside in Detroit, Michigan. I have worked in music for 4 years, and have been active in the web3 space for almost 2 years. Over the past 4 years I have garnered over 2.5 Million Streams, performed alongside Kanye West with the Sunday Service choir, and played shows across the United States, all independently.

Recently, we’ve seen a sharp rise in the occurrence of virtual bands, AI & computer generated music, &  fictional social media characters. From The Archies & Gorillaz, to modern day Lil Miquela, Yameii Online, and Teflon Sega, this is a trend that is quickly picking up steam.

**I will create a virtual band based on Lil Nouns NFTs & release CC0 music. **My producer and I will create and release a 1 song “pilot” distributed under a dedicated nounish artist page. Lil Nouns will be featured on the cover art of the song. proposals.title: Lil Nouns Mascot with Halloween Theme
proposals.tldr: Lil Nouns Mascot, making a mascot as a promotional and branding media from Lil Nouns with a special Halloween theme
proposals.content:
![](https://i.imgur.com/WLyCl2Z.png)

# Summary

**• Objectives for this proposal**

- Introducing NFT Lil Nouns to the wider community to provide knowledge about what Lil Nouns are.
- Attract new builders especially in Indonesia that we as citizens of a “developing” country can also make extraordinary proposals and executions.
- Enliven the halloween event by creating content with the main character Lil Nouns Mascot to educate the public about NFT and Crypto.
**• Strategies:**

- Make a Lil Nouns mascot with a Halloween theme.
- Produce and publish high quality videos about Crypto, NFT, and Lil Nouns DAO.
- Update each stage of the activity to completion on Instagram and Twitter via Nouns Indonesia.
- Promoting by joining car free day and inviting as many people as possible to create stories with Lil Nouns.
**• Measuring Success**

We will calculate the success target as follows:

- Total views from [Twitter](https://twitter.com/NounsIndonesia) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/nounsindonesia/?hl=en) reach 3000 for all videos.
- Total likes from [Twitter](https://twitter.com/NounsIndonesia) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/nounsindonesia/?hl=en) reached 200 for all videos.
- The total number of Instagram stories and twitter posts mentioning **Nouns Indonesian** has reached 40 people.
- The total number of people who came to see the mascot immediately reached 40 people.
We will spread the results of the target to the Lil Nouns community.

**• Deliverables**

- 3-4 high production videos.
- 15+ short form videos.
- Daily post during work until after work.
**• Staffing & Resources**

A team of 1 full-timers and 2 part timers (PemburuX, Doni and Yunus)

# Lil Nouns Mascot Making Background

The background of making lil nouns mascot with a Halloween theme comes from [punk4156](https://twitter.com/punk4156/status/1578436559732625408) tweet.

![](https://i.imgur.com/i2pkvuY.png)

I'm interested in taking up the challenge by making the first mascot costume from lil nouns with a Halloween theme. The Halloween theme was chosen because on October 31 the whole world will welcome one of the biggest events, the Halloween event. To enliven the event, I will make a mascot for the first time and it will be displayed at the Halloween event.

# The Reason for Making Lil Nouns Mascot

Mascot is one of the media to do the most effective promotion. Because of its large size the size of a normal human, it attracts a lot of people's attention. Then the mascot can be a representation of NFT lil nouns that exist in the real world or can be called a bridge in connecting the NFT world with the real world. This mascot will not only be used once, but can be used repeatedly for subsequent events.

# Lil Nouns Mask Mascot Making Plan

I have discussed the plan to make this special mascot for lil nouns with my friend and founder of one of the biggest mascot making vendors in Indonesia, namely indomascot.com. In this conversation I have discussed at length to determine the initial design, budget, duration of work, delivery, and work agreements. The result of the discussion is that this lil nouns mascot will later have a size for adults whose height is generally 170-190cm. then the material used is cloth with no 1 quality on the market. This fabric is not hot and soft so as to provide comfort for the talent to wear this mascot later. The type of velboa (doll), drill to lotto used later has a high degree of similarity with the original design.

![](https://i.imgur.com/iYgaXJ1.png)

After making the mascot is complete, then the mascot will be sent to our house for the video production process. where is the location for making videos, namely during car free day and at other special locations. When the video is taken during car free day to attract the attention of the public, we will give special Lil Nouns souvenirs to people who have taken pictures and uploaded them on their social media.

# Work Time

The process of making this lil nouns mascot will take 7-14 days. Then the shipping process takes about 7 days. After that the video production process will start after the mascot arrives at my house and will be completed for 14 days. So the total time needed to complete this proposal is 35 days or less. Work on this mascot will be carried out immediately after this proposal is approved.

# Budget

The details of the budget we need for this proposal are as follows:

• Mascot Design Creation: $100

• Purchase of Materials for Mascot: $400

• Service for mascot creation: $500

• Shipping and Insurance: $200

• Mascot Talent: $200

• Souvenir Car Freeday: $250

• Video Production: $800

• Legal & forex fees: $150

**Total: $2600 ~ 2 ETH**

Faishal a.k.a pemburux.eth

I'm a content creator, editor, and [lil nouners #6057](https://opensea.io/assets/ethereum/0x4b10701bfd7bfedc47d50562b76b436fbb5bdb3b/6057). So far, I have created more than 20 content on tiktok, youtube and twitter. Where all the content I wrote my own concept. proposals.title: LucidHaus - Haus Catalogue
proposals.tldr: Fund LucidHaus to continue development of open source tooling for musicians & artist DAO’s
proposals.content:
# **details, **

taayyohh -- ([lil noun 806](https://etherscan.io/token/0x4b10701bfd7bfedc47d50562b76b436fbb5bdb3b?a=806#inventory)), Co-Founder of [LucidHaus](https://lucid.haus/), an artist owned & operated record label based in Brooklyn, New York and Engineer at [Zora](https://zora.co/), helping to build the [Nouns Builder](https://twitter.com/nounsbuilder) -- has been working on a project for LucidHaus to release their back catalogue on chain.

**Haus Catalogue **

https://github.com/taayyohh/haus-catalogue

Haus Catalogue is a dapp that allows any Artist on our roster (apart of a merkle tree) to mint a single ERC-721 Token (a song) to the same token address. In other words, our label LucidHaus will have a $LUCI NFT where each Token is a different song of an Artist, composing our entire catalog.

The front end allows a user to listen to and create playlists of songs and will allow filtering by Album, Artist, Genre etc. It allows uses [Zora's V3 ReserveAuctionCoreETH Module ](https://docs.zora.co/docs/smart-contracts/modules/ReserveAuctions/Core/zora-v3-auctions-coreETH) to allow for:

- creating an auction,
- cancelling an auction,
- changing auction reserve bid price
- creating a bid
- settling an auction

We will be using[ 0xsplits](https://app.0xsplits.xyz/splits/?chainId=5) to split sellerRecipientFunds between the Artist and the Label and and additional parties involved in the creation of the art.

Inspired by [Catalog](https://beta.catalog.works/) -- Haus Catalogue forks and modifies the ["Catalog" contract](https://etherscan.io/address/0x1d90cd67ac5c30f5cb396b3cc47f0d92c572b372#code%23F1%23L1), with a new front end written with the intention of making Haus Catalogue as forkable as possible.

There is a Goerli version up at https://haus-catalogue.vercel.app/ where development is actively happening, with the hopes of launching on mainnet in few weeks or less.

Funding would allow the team to prioritize abstracting the code as much as possible to make it as reusable as possible for other developers and as easy to deploy for other non-developer artists looking to do a similar thing.

LucidHaus is also newly crypto native and attempting to begin operating as DAO as possible.(lucidhaus.eth is our multisig) -- 1ETH would be allocated to our treasury to fund our artists projects. We want to open source and document the way we create proposals and vote and fund and track our funding of our artists so we can help other artists and collectives of artists do the same.

# **roadmap, **

- Mainnet (few weeks)
- Improvements + Open Source (few months)

proposals.author: 0xb17963964a3dbeae93e550041728509de60d73d3
proposals.title: Training girls to Create Reusable Pads
proposals.tldr: Lil Noun Team in Uganda teaching girls in rural schools how to make reusable pads in Uganda
proposals.content:
## Introduction;

Sexual Maturation and menstruation management are areas that continue to suffer silently because of inadequate promotion in schools. This is due to lack of resources in the different schools especially since many of the pupils hardly pay above $20 per term in school.

Many girls drop out of school at this stage because they do not know how to take care of themselves due to lack of information, un developed life skills, lack the facilities in the school to manage their menstruation appropriately and more especially unable to afford sanitary towels.

“In our village, the girls and women use dry banana fibres during menstruation, they harbour the blood but smell badly after use…..” said by village woman in Jinja district

According to a baseline survey conducted by Plan Uganda, many girls opt to stay at home during menstruation. Poor menstruation management leads to absenteeism, poor performance and drop out as the end result.

It is against this background that Lil Nouns would like to equip Girls with skills of making affordable and reusable sanitary pads so as to promote retention in school and improve their performance too in class.

## How will this benefit the DAO;

Through this activity, we will be able to;

- Create awareness about NFTs (Lil Nouns) through branding
- Teach the girls how to make their own reusable pads for their benefit as well as a way of making extra income.
- Create a Lil Nouns clubs in these schools so that we have a ripple effect on everyone in the school and community

**Funds breakdown;**

2ETH (USD 2716.94) according to the value at this time

Materials = 1

Facilitators = 0.3

Operations = 0.2

Logisitics/Transportation = 0.2

Merchandise = 0.3

[Pavua](https://twitter.com/p_avua) will be in charge of execution with facilitators from [Shuya](https://twitter.com/shuya_pads). It was only last week when she went for CRS with [Remax Uganda](https://twitter.com/remax_uganda) in relation to the girl child. She feels there is still more we can do such as training them in producing reusable pads hence creating skilled girls.

[Pictures of the our recent CRS](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xvqSaKxrYwZn4KMasUnaysTVXK1bTR1k/view?usp=sharing)

proposals.author: 0xfb7607cb69cc14e9ccd76fbcc6ea099f1db4c2c2
proposals.title: lil Nouns school Empowerment project
proposals.tldr: Providing poor kids with lil nouns branded scholastic materials and beautifying schools in uganda with lil-nouns art.
proposals.content:
In Uganda and Africa, we have alot of financially disadvantaged schools that do not even have enough funds to paint their classroom building. we have financially deprived and unprivileged kids that cannot afford school scholastic materials like pens, books, pencils among others.

![](https://i.imgur.com/Sf670GWl.jpg)

With 2 Eth from the lil nouns pro house, we will develop and design lil nouns branded scholastic materials like lil noun pens, lil noun books, lil noun bags, lil noun pencils which we will give out and distribute to the kids, pupils and students to help them in their education journey. some of the design samples for the nouns products are attached below:

![](https://i.imgur.com/MM4e3bnm.jpg)

![](https://i.imgur.com/kOaP5txm.jpg)

![](https://i.imgur.com/wPIwHBhm.jpg)

![](https://i.imgur.com/MbrVaoOm.jpg)

we will also are going to beautify paint these schools with lil nouns art.

![](https://i.imgur.com/4b6tu5tl.jpg)

With this inititative, the web 3 space specifically nouns prop house will have had a significant impact towards the educative sector in Uganda by enabling kids have access to basic school requirements.

**Budget spend**

- 0.5 eth- making the lil nouns branded scholastic materials(bags, pens,pencils,books)
- 1 eth- to beautify and paint the school with lil nouns art.
- 0.5 eth- documenting to lil nouns project( photography and videography)
**Roadmoap:**

1.production on materials(pens, books, bags) will be finalized by november 10.

2.distribution of the material will take place on november 20th in kampala schools.

3.painting of the nouns art in a school will take place on 1 december.

**Team:**

Malcomeranda: [https://twitter.com/MALCOM_ERANDA](https://twitter.com/MALCOM_ERANDA)

[https://www.instagram.com/malcomz_world/](https://www.instagram.com/malcomz_world/)

nyero timothy: [https://www.instagram.com/nyero_timothy/?hl=en](https://www.instagram.com/nyero_timothy/?hl=en)

The 2 eth funding from lil nouns prop house will contribute towards to future of these children.

Thank you.

proposals.content:

My mission in making this hunt is to introduce people to Lilnouns and at the same time i wanna make people more aware of safety driving. The thing that makes it interesting is that every day around 20,000-30,000 motorbikes are used for daily activities. As far as I know, this is the first nft-based hunt in my city maybe in Indonesia too, cmiiw.

Terms and conditions in this hunt:

1.I will distribute first 100 Lilnouns helmet in 10 different locations in the city to random people,

2.This hunt consists of 10 rounds. 1 Lilnouns will be drawn every 3 days to be searched by people,

3.The fastest person who can take a photo or video is the winner,

4.The person who can take photos of ten Lilnouns from all rounds will get the grand prize.

2.@exploresemarang (explore the city)

3.@kakilimasemarang (food blogger

4.@faizalaaa_ (gamer)

5.@hangoutsemarang (content creator)

Helmet production: 2 months

the hunt: 5 weeks

proposals.author: 0xf4ff19c30c98533fd6d3cecf09b3d6802e470dd0
proposals.title: Animated Lil Nouns Sprite Sheets UPGRADE - Additional Traits + CC0 Asset Library
proposals.tldr: Design, Development and Hosting of additional animated Lil Nouns sprite sheet traits for Pixel Metaverse/Games
proposals.content:
![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmTcVbmf3swDFgiAnKo7doSkfMg2U2S14H2tXHscXmiTUA)

**Project details:**

As an extension of work already on-going with Prop House #1466 (pants only animations) and further explorations into the designs between different collections in the Nouns ecosystem, I would like to create assets to be more inclusive to all by building and animating additional traits (shorts, short dress and long dress) for the Animated Lil Nouns Sprite Sheets.

All Lil Nouns Sprite Sheet Assets will then be organized and hosted on Figma.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmShPVLCn6iGyN8berWACS4QCSN5C5uTJ895ULkQz2KhXg)

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmTtAk1msr3ZToGLduStUktNhrPSUGDnmzxZhKoBtLspiM)

**The Plan:**

I will complete building animated sprite sheets for the Lil Nouns Collection with 3 additional lower body traits in 34 different color options each (shorts, short and long dress). This Lil Nouns sprite sheet collection will include the walk and idle cycles necessary for easy integration into games and metaverse platforms such as Worldwide Webb3.

After the work on sprite sheets have been finalized, a Sprite Sheet Asset Library would be created (most likely in Figma) for the community to have access to the assets and be able to build and download their own custom sprite sheets.

A Lil Nouns full-body design reference will also be include in the Asset Library to allow for future Lil Nouns design iterations and animations.

**What are sprite sheets?**

Sprite sheets are used in games to animate the characters on the screen. They’re a collection of single frame animations, laid out like a film strip. The most common animations for sprite sheets are the idle sequence (character moving while standing still) and walking cycles (stylistic walk as the character moves around the map)

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmVVpnGWbrt5HT2mwYSnQTU5LEjhQW4HKPv75CyquqSSUs)

As part of Prop House !1466, this is an example of a pixel art sprite sheet created for Worldwide Web3 integration using dasher#0319’s Lil Nouns #2999 (full-body)

**Timeline:**

approx 3-4 weeks (sprite sheet creation + asset library creation and organization)

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmRWD5Jvf3yTJbRMHXzWa2mmENhe5BVpb3NvySC5cpqPkR)

**Why Kerimbonia?:**

I’m a professional 3D artist with over 20 years of experience. Previous clients include Nintendo, Warner Bros., Lamborghini, Calvin Harris, Taylor Swift, Justin Timberlake, Rihanna, Travis Scott, to name a few.

Prop House #1466 has already been funded and is approx. 75% completed. This round of prop house will extend the scope of what was originally planned and create a more complete and gender-inclusive sprite sheet collection.

I also created the sprite sheets for the entire CryptoDickbutts collection and am responsible for their integration into Worldwide Web3. I was also the creator of Escape from Gooch Island Game (CryptoDickbutts) and have also assisted Meebits DAO with early 3D-to-Pixel Art rendering workflows and advised Pixel Shop in getting the Meebits integrated into Worldwide Web3 as well.

[https://twitter.com/CryptoDickbutts/status/1568031884315136004](https://twitter.com/CryptoDickbutts/status/1568031884315136004)

I love pixel art, animation and believe in the power of being able to totally embody characters in the metaverse, and the value of being able to socialize and play games as our favorite NFTs… in this case, Lil Nouns!
